tune.amendment: 2026-09-24: the grid was {1, 3, 8}; in the first encoder stage every arm selected 8 while still improving (+0.02 to +0.05 from 3 to 8), so the budget was censored. Every stage, including a re-run encoder stage, uses one run per rate scored after 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32 epochs
tune.criterion: mean over families of frozen accuracy on the tune range; ties -> fewer epochs, then lower rate
